author: agent:claude-code
message: Forest lands: parda's prototype (parda2D crates/sylva-forest) moved into src/forest.rs, fitted to sylva (Tree's move_to contract, insert_after, generation parity instead of an alive array, sylva's errors), with its tests and the arena benchmarks. Status stays building: two of the speed rule's cases (a 100k build, reordering children) are still behind the arena. (proposal 01a10ac4-251f-77e8-b79c-2beb99c92172, proposed by agent:claude-code, accepted by user)

title: Close the forest's two gaps against the arena
body: benches/forest.rs, medians: building 100k nodes 1.12-1.16 ms against the arena's 1.02-1.13 ms (3-10%, noisy; level at 10k), and moving the root's last child to the front 12 ns against 4 ns (the arena memmoves 16 u32s; the forest checks three ids and walks the new parent's ancestors first). Merging the generation into the links record was considered and not taken: it widens every link walk to win a few percent on build.

title: Forest::move_to keeps Tree's contract
body: It returns false, changing nothing (not even the version), when the node is already where it was asked to go, and fails without changing anything on a cycle or a wrong `before`. So a no-op move never forces a Flat rebuild, and callers report no-ops the same way for both trees. The prototype returned () and bumped the version.

title: A slot's generation's parity says whether it's alive
body: Even while a node lives in the slot, odd while it's free; freeing and reusing each bump it. An id always carries an even generation, so `contains` is one comparison and the prototype's separate alive array is gone (one array fewer per node). A slot's ids wrap after 2^31 reuses.

title: Moved in from parda's prototype
body: parda-2d wrote the forest as crates/sylva-forest against sylva 9d2a15d (graft 01a10a64-df76) and asked for it to move here. Its tests and benchmarks came with it; parda can depend on sylva::forest and drop its crate.

title: Edited docs/DESIGN.md by hand after it became a Tend document
body: The edits were refused by doc_write until recorded. Lesson: once doc_import publishes a file, change it only through doc_write (draft the text elsewhere, then write it); a hand edit needs the user's `tend doc sync`.
